answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable copper-denominated bond and earn vouches only from members who completed a full epoch without a flag; a newcomer may wander the network freely but cannot vote or claim rewards until the bond and two independent vouches are in place. Creating ten thousand fake identities then means locking ten thousand bonds and finding ten thousand distinct vouchers, so the attacker capital cost scales linearly while honest members pay once. A violet flag from any juror freezes the bond pending review, turning fake farms into frozen capital instead of profit.
